liquidation(address).details: `liquidatesAbove` is true for a short: the asset rising is what liquidates it.

noteRefund(address,uint256,uint256).details: USDC borrowed that the LP did not use. It went back to the owner, so it is not principal.

openBasket(address,address,uint256,(addr.details: Each leg route is quoted for a seed size and scaled to the borrow Aave actually allows.

books(address).notice: Book on this accountant, or the one still stored on the accountant it replaced.

debtOf(address,address).notice: Live Aave debt, interest included. This is the amount `repay` must cover.

liquidation(address).notice: Isolated liquidation price in oracle units (8 decimals), plus the account health factor.

openBasket(address,address,uint256,(addr.notice: Supply `collateral`, then borrow USDC and buy each leg. One debt, several aTokens.

seized(address).notice: True when Aave has already taken collateral or repaid debt outside this book.         Supply is omitted: it has no loan. `debtLeft` is the live debt, interest included.

settleLeveraged(address,uint256).notice: LP proceeds and any top-up are already on this contract. Repay, sell the collateral, return USDC.
